agilent_app_note.title: Monitoring Growth of Beer Brewing Strains of Saccharomyces cerevisiae

locators.sealed_plate: page 7: adhesive sealers are necessary for long kinetic assays; 200 uL works well in 96-well flat-bottom plates

plr_0_2_1_local_signatures.shake_mapping_note: BioTekPlateReaderBackend.shake calls frequency a device setting in the range 1..6; its source comment maps setting 3 to 567 CPM and setting 1 to 1096 CPM. It does not expose independent CPM and amplitude arguments.
